summary: Mostaque expects AI to take over remote knowledge work soon, takes AI risk seriously and argues for open models owned by the people they serve.

statements.quote: If your job can be done on the other side of a screen the AI can do it better
We wrote them a constitution and left the upbringing to the internet.
Capability sets how much a misaligned system can do, and character decides whether it does.
When capital no longer needs labor, how does labor get capital?
We have to make sure it’s owned by the people. And then we have a shot at abundance.
